title: Vampire Bat (Animated)
author: rubberduck
processing: Blender 4.2.0, existing local official distribution; source loaded with auto-execution disabled.
Source anatomical bat model and authored Bat_Flying animation. No generated model or replacement procedural wing shape.
Decimate modifier reduced 7732 triangles to 1700 before armature evaluation; UVs and rig weights retained for baking.
All eight source action frames explicitly evaluated into identical-topology position and smooth-normal poses. Source hidden layer collections enabled before evaluation.
Blender Z-up converted to Three Y-up; normalized to 2.8m reference wingspan. Seven scene instances range 2.41m to 3.5m.
Five hero/caldera flight paths remain in front. Two high, wide basin circuits cover every side and the rear sky, with verified rear flyers at0/24/45seconds. No extra instances or geometry.
Source body and parts textures combined into one 1K atlas; saturation scaled to0.55. Normal atlas512. No bright substituted eyes.
One opaque instanced mesh uses Three r186 texture-backed morph targets. Only7matrices448bytes and7x9float morph weights252bytes upload per frame.
Source archive, frost alternative, other actions, source scene lights and HDRI remain outside public runtime.
limits: Offline reduction and authored motion preserve source character but are adaptations, not a biological flight simulation.
Desktop and physical Quest performance require integration testing by the root task.
